}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "ROCK 5B V1.45 2023.04.25" is silkscreened on board top.
{{See also|Radxa|List of Single-board computers}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3588 @2.4GHz Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A76) :+ @1.8GHz Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A55) *GPU: ''Mali-G610'' MP4 (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.2); NPU Support 6T, :VPU (with 8K@60fps VP9 and 8K@30fps H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 16MB (SPI) Flash, eMMC module connector, :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card, NVMe SSD (M.2) slot *Memory: 8GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM ([[Micron]]) *USB: 1x USB 3.1 (Type-C) DP1.4/OT port, :2x USB 3.0 (USB 3.1 Gen 1), 2x USB 2.0 ports *PCIe: 1x M.2 (M key) socket, 1x M.2 (E key) socket *Network: 1x 2.5Gb Ethernet port (w/ PoE support) *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: USB Type-C (supporting USB PD 2.0) :or via optional PoE Hat
